description:
### Overall Layout
A clean, minimalist single-panel scientific diagram set against a seamless, solid white background with generous surrounding whitespace. The composition is strictly aligned along a central vertical axis, comprising a left-aligned top header, a centered, perfectly square 14×14 mutual-information heatmap matrix with translucent crosshair highlights, and a crisp mathematical equation centered directly underneath the matrix.

### Header
- **Index Badge**: A small, perfectly circular solid black badge containing a crisp, centered white numeral '1' in a bold sans-serif typeface, anchored at the top-left corner.
- **Section Title**: A prominent, bold black sans-serif label reading 'Dependence', positioned horizontally adjacent to the circular badge with comfortable spacing.
- **Sub-label Chip**: Positioned just beneath the title, an elongated capsule-shaped tag with a very soft, light neutral grey fill and a thin, solid cobalt blue accent bar along its left vertical edge. Inside, the phrase 'query–key score' is printed in a clean, medium-weight charcoal grey sans-serif font.

### Central Heatmap Matrix (14×14 Grid)
- **Matrix Architecture**: Exactly 14 rows and 14 columns of square cells representing pairwise mutual information ($D$) between 14 genes, separated by ultra-thin, hairline white cell dividers for clean individual definition.
- **Coordinate Labels**: Subtle, clean grey sans-serif index numbers '1' and '14' clearly mark the start and end of the rows and columns at the top, bottom, left, and right margins without redundant duplicate numerals.
- **Main Diagonal Baseline**: Every self-interaction cell strictly along the main diagonal $(k, k)$ from $(1, 1)$ to $(14, 14)$ has a uniform, desaturated soft warm grey fill. There are zero off-diagonal grey cells.
- **Sequential Blue Scale & Block Structure**:
  - **Chain Block 1 (Genes 4–9)**: Rows 4 through 9 and columns 4 through 9 form a distinct dark blue cluster block with graded mid-to-dark blue off-diagonal cells and grey diagonal cells.
  - **Chain Block 2 (Genes 10–13)**: Rows 10 through 13 and columns 10 through 13 form a secondary moderate denim-blue cluster block.
  - **Background / Weak Coupling**: All remaining off-diagonal cells (including rows/columns 1–3 and gene 14) are rendered in a delicate, very pale powder blue with subtle realistic variation.

### Selection Overlays & Intersection
- **Gene $i$ Row Highlight**: Spanning horizontally across exactly row 4, a flat, translucent soft pastel blue band covers all 14 cells. It is bounded along its top and bottom edges by fine, crisp navy blue borderlines. Directly outside the left margin of the grid, aligned with row 4, sits the text label 'gene i' in bold deep blue sans-serif typography.
- **Gene $j$ Column Highlight**: Spanning vertically down exactly column 5, a flat, translucent soft rose-pink band extends through all 14 rows. It is bounded along its left and right edges by fine, crisp magenta borderlines. Directly above the top margin of the grid, aligned with column 5, sits the text label 'gene j' in bold deep crimson sans-serif typography.
- **Intersection Cell $(i, j)$**: Located precisely at row 4, column 5 where the horizontal blue and vertical pink bands cross, the individual cell is highlighted by a sharp, prominent solid black rectangular outline that rests on top of the translucent color blend, isolating the evaluated mutual information score.

### Annotations & Math
- **Bottom Equation**: Centered neatly beneath the heatmap grid with clear breathing room, formatted in publication-grade mathematical typography:
  $$D_{ij} = \text{MI}(i, j) = 0.31$$
  where $D$ and indices $i, j$ are rendered in elegant italic serif math type, 'MI' is set in upright sans-serif text, and the numerical value '0.31' is crisp and legible.

### Visual Styling & Aesthetic Balance
- **Linework**: Razor-sharp, consistent hairline weights for grid structure and overlay bounds; bold black line weight reserved exclusively for the black intersection focus cell at $(4, 5)$.
- **Typography**: Modern, publication-quality sans-serif for headers and gene labels paired with LaTeX-style mathematical typesetting for variables.

critic_suggestions: Grid Dimensions: The heatmap currently has only 13 rows and 13 columns. It must be corrected to have exactly 14 rows and 14 columns (indices 1 through 14 on both axes), ensuring gene 14 forms a proper 14th row and 14th column.

Row/Column Band & Target Cell Misalignment: 'gene i' band is currently drawn on row 5, causing the intersection with 'gene j' (column 5) to fall on the diagonal cell (5, 5). The 'gene i' blue band must be strictly shifted to row 4, so the intersection cell outlined in black is precisely at off-diagonal location (row 4, column 5).

Diagonal Continuity: Ensure the uniform warm-grey diagonal strictly runs along all 14 self-interaction coordinates (k, k) from (1, 1) to (14, 14). Specifically, cell (4, 4) and cell (5, 5) must be grey, while cell (4, 5) is an off-diagonal blue-scaled mutual information cell.

Block Architecture & Color Palette: Ensure Block 1 encompasses genes 4–9 (a 6×6 submatrix across rows 4–9, columns 4–9) and Block 2 spans genes 10–13 (a 4×4 submatrix across rows 10–13, columns 10–13). Soften the dark blue palette into a graded scientific pale-to-deep blue sequential scale, avoiding oversaturated flat navy.
critique.revised_description:
### Overall Layout
A clean, minimalist single-panel scientific diagram set against a solid, seamless white background with generous margins. The panel is vertically aligned, featuring a top-left panel header, a perfectly square 14×14 mutual-information heatmap matrix centered in the frame, and a publication-quality mathematical equation centered directly underneath.

### Header
- **Index Badge**: A small, solid black circular badge containing a clean, centered white numeral '1' in bold sans-serif type, positioned at the top-left.
- **Title**: A bold black sans-serif label reading 'Dependence', positioned adjacent to the circular badge.
- **Sub-label Chip**: Positioned directly beneath the title, a rounded horizontal tag with a soft neutral light-grey fill and a crisp cobalt blue accent bar along its left vertical edge. Inside, the text 'query–key score' is set in a medium-weight charcoal sans-serif font.

### Central Heatmap Matrix (Strictly 14×14 Grid)
- **Grid Architecture**: Exactly 14 rows and 14 columns of equal-sized square cells representing pairwise mutual information ($D$) among 14 genes, separated by ultra-thin, hairline white gridlines.
- **Coordinate Labels**: Unobtrusive, clean grey sans-serif numerals '1' and '14' mark the first and fourteenth rows and columns along the outer perimeter (top, bottom, left, and right margins).
- **Main Diagonal (Self-Interaction)**: All 14 diagonal cells $(k, k)$ from $(1, 1)$ down to $(14, 14)$ are uniformly filled with a flat, desaturated warm-grey. No off-diagonal cell contains grey.
- **Block Structure & Sequential Blue Ramp**:
  - **Block 1 (Genes 4–9)**: A 6×6 block spanning rows 4 to 9 and columns 4 to 9 rendered in graded mid-to-dark blue tones representing strong mutual information, pierced along the diagonal by grey cells $(4,4)$ through $(9,9)$.
  - **Block 2 (Genes 10–13)**: A 4×4 block spanning rows 10 to 13 and columns 10 to 13 rendered in moderate slate/denim blue tones, with grey diagonal cells $(10,10)$ through $(13,13)$.
  - **Background & Uncoupled Genes**: All remaining off-diagonal cells (genes 1–3, gene 14, and cross-block pairs) are colored in a delicate, very pale powder blue with subtle realistic gradations.

### Selection Overlays & Intersection
- **Gene $i$ Row Highlight**: Spans horizontally across precisely row 4 across all 14 columns as a flat, translucent soft blue band, bounded top and bottom by fine navy borders. Aligned directly to the left of row 4 outside the grid is the bold blue sans-serif label 'gene i'.
- **Gene $j$ Column Highlight**: Spans vertically down precisely column 5 across all 14 rows as a flat, translucent soft rose-pink band, bounded left and right by fine crimson borders. Aligned directly above column 5 outside the grid is the bold crimson sans-serif label 'gene j'.
- **Target Intersection Cell $(4, 5)$**: The intersection of row 4 and column 5 forms an off-diagonal cell. It is highlighted with a crisp, solid black border around its perimeter, overlaying the translucent blended color to distinctly isolate the evaluated mutual information score $D_{ij}$.

### Mathematical Annotation
- **Bottom Equation**: Centered neatly beneath the heatmap grid with ample breathing space:
  $$D_{ij} = \text{MI}(i, j) = 0.31$$
  Typeset with italic serif variables $D, i, j$, standard upright text for 'MI', and crisp numerals for '0.31'.

### Linework & Styling
- Minimal ink aesthetic with hairline cell separators and boundary strokes; distinct medium-weight black stroke strictly reserved for the focus box around cell $(4, 5)$.

user_feedback: The matrix MUST have exactly 14 rows and 14 columns like the content reference (you drew 13). Copy the content reference cell by cell: grey self-diagonal from top-left to bottom-right, the dark blue block on genes 4 to 9 (rows 4-9, columns 4-9) with graded mid-blue cells, a moderate lighter-blue block on genes 10 to 13, and the remaining cells very light blue with subtle variation. Gene i band is row 4, gene j band is column 5, traced cell at row 4 column 5. Use the same pale-to-dark blue ramp as the reference, not saturated navy. Do not add or move any block.
